structured_output.rationale: 271 confirms EB*6 with DTP*357=20250930; DOS is 20251018 — 18 days after coverage ended. CO-27 on all three lines under a CI (commercial) payer. Per 05-eligibility-terminated.md, CO-27 on a commercial claim is not an automatic write-off; hold-harmless binds only active members, so the patient owes the balance once standard overrides are cleared. No QMB, Medicaid, NSA, or ACA grace-period signal in any artifact.

root_cause.explanation: 271 shows EB*6 with DTP*357=20250930; DOS 20251018 is 18 days post-termination. All three lines carry CO-27 under CI commercial payer.

next_action.detail: Verify no QMB/Medicaid/NSA override applies, then bill Susan Harris $150.57. The hold-harmless clause does not cover services rendered after her coverage ended 2025-09-30.
